steps.action: Establish eligible subscribers, qualifying public uploads, watch hours or Shorts engaged-view thresholds; meet policies and regional requirements.
steps.limits: Paid campaign-generated views/watch time don't count; organic follow-on views can under specific rules.

steps.action: Submit the YPP application from Studio and accept relevant base terms.
steps.limits: Terms can change and additional module acceptance is required for specific earning products.

steps.action: Set up or link an active AdSense for YouTube account.
steps.limits: Valid identity, country, age/payment and verification requirements may apply; no banking information is stored here.

steps.action: Automated and human review assesses the channel's policy compliance.
steps.limits: Volume, repeat review or disagreement can extend the review process. Meeting numerical thresholds does not guarantee approval.

steps.action: A first rejection can be appealed within the published window.
steps.limits: A valid appeal is not guaranteed to succeed.

steps.action: First-time rejected applicants can continue compliant uploads and request another review after the waiting period.
steps.limits: Rules depend on case history and published program policy.

steps.action: Later repeat applications usually have a longer cooldown.
steps.limits: Do not assume every rejection automatically uses the same path.

steps.action: Accept product modules and satisfy feature-specific conditions for ads, Supers, memberships, Shopping or gifts.
steps.limits: Not all products are automatically available after base YPP approval.

steps.action: Earning activity is subject to adjustments, payout thresholds, verification, withholding and payment timing.
steps.limits: Cash settlement may occur much later than view accrual or program approval.

guardrails: The typical one-month review is not an approval guarantee or a bound on first payout.
A reapplication cooldown is not a recommended way to build a business.
Do not buy advertising views for the purpose of defeating eligibility thresholds.
No bank account, tax ID, channel credentials or personal appeal information belongs in this public dossier.
The information is general, not an evaluation of any creator's eligibility.
